commands.command: set -u; echo '=== USBMODEM NODES ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/tty.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== USB SERIAL NODES (names only) ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbserial* /dev/tty.usbserial* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== ESPRESSIF USB TREE ==='; system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E -B4 -A16 'Espressif|USB JTAG|Serial/JTAG|303a|ESP32' || true
